declarations.description:
An inbox panel of notifications, like GitHub's notifications, Linear's inbox and the Carbon notification panel:
newest first, grouped by day, the unread ones marked, with an All / Unread filter and "Mark all as read". It is a
panel only; put it in a `c2-overlay` for a bell-icon dropdown, in a `c2-sheet`, or in a page column.

Each item shows who it is from (`avatar`), what happened (`title`, `body`) and when (a `c2-relative-time`). The whole
item is one link (with `href`) or button, and activating it fires a cancelable `notification-click`, then marks it
read. A toggle beside it marks it read or unread. Every change of read state fires a cancelable `read-change` with
the ids, then updates `notifications`; cancel it to keep the panel controlled, for example to wait for a server.

`has-more` adds a Load more button that fires `load-more`, with `loading` while the next page arrives. The `empty`
slot replaces the message shown when there is nothing to list.

The panel is a region named by its title; each day is a list named by its title; an unread item reads as
"Unread: …", and a live region confirms "All notifications marked as read".

members.name: notifications
members.description: The notifications. As an attribute, a JSON array of `{ id, title, body, time, read, href, avatar, group }`.

members.name: filter
members.description: Which notifications are listed. The All / Unread buttons set it.

members.name: groupBy
members.description: How the list is grouped: by day (Today, Yesterday, then the date), by each item's `group`, or not at all.

members.name: hasMore
members.description: Adds a Load more button at the end of the list, which fires `load-more`.

members.name: loading
members.description: Marks the Load more button busy while the next page arrives.

members.name: label
members.description: The title. Defaults to "Notifications" in the page's language.

members.name: announcement
members.description: What the live region says, cleared after it has been read.

members.name: list
members.description: The items that can be shown: an id (string or number) and a title. Others stay in `notifications` untouched.

members.name: setRead
members.description: Announces a read change about to happen, then applies it unless the event was cancelled.

events.name: read-change
events.description: The user marked items read or unread. Cancelable: cancel it to leave `notifications` unchanged.

events.name: notification-click
events.description: An item was activated. Cancelable: cancelling it keeps the item unread and stops a link from being followed.

events.name: filter-change
events.description: The user switched between All and Unread; `filter` is already updated.

events.name: load-more
events.description: The Load more button was pressed.
